name: Harstad County Park
note: Eau Claire County park on the Eau Claire River at the mouth of Bridge Creek, between Augusta and Fall Creek: wooded sites spread along gravel spurs, a canoe landing, pavilion, ball field and playground. Self-registration at the park; not reservable online. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Eau Claire County Parks page (eccountyparks.com Harstad County Park Shelter details, read 2026-11-17): '27-site campground, with 10 sites having 50/30/20 amp electrical service ... Camping (self-registration at the park) - $20.00/night for non-electric ... $25.00/night for electric site'; county camping page (read 2026-11-17): 'Coon Fork and Harstad campgrounds are open for the season May 1st - September 15th' -> current county campground; 50-amp sites, Campendium 2023-08-03 reviewer ('some perfect for bigger camper #13 & 27') and Esri imagery (drive-in gravel spurs off an internal road, rigs on pads) -> drive-in RV sites a 23-ft rig fits, no length cap posted. Google Maps 4.4/87, not closed. Not a horse camp. Public (local): no price gate. Duplicate check 2026-11-17: no 'Harstad' entry; nearest entry 3457 Coon Fork 13 km.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-17: Esri World Imagery (700 m, 500 m and 300 m frames at 44.7390,-91.1697 / 44.7375,-91.1655 / 44.7383,-91.1675, all rendered): the campsites are small clearings along gravel spurs under continuous forest canopy south-west of the confluence; the nearest site clearings are ~50-100 m from Bridge Creek and the Eau Claire River through a dense, unbroken tree band, and the open ground by the water is the day-use pavilion/canoe-landing area to the north (the county's 'outstanding views of the mouth of Bridge Creek and the Eau Claire River' are the pavilion's). No official site map or site photo shows a site overlooking water; aggregator 'sites overlook the river' (The Dyrt) is not evidence -> not waterfront. No dam in play.

sites.note: 10 sites have 50/30/20-amp electric; the rest are non-electric.

sites_source: https://www.eccountyparks.com/parks/parks-and-shelters/harstad_county_park_shelter/details/ ('27-site campground, with 10 sites having 50/30/20 amp electrical service'), read 2026-11-17
hookups_source: https://www.eccountyparks.com/parks/parks-and-shelters/harstad_county_park_shelter/details/ ('27-site campground, with 10 sites having 50/30/20 amp electrical service'; facilities list gives only 'pit toilets, water pump' - no water or sewer service), read 2026-11-17
facilities_source: https://www.eccountyparks.com/parks/parks-and-shelters/harstad_county_park_shelter/details/ ('Harstad Park has electricity and does includes the following facilities: picnic area with grills, a playground, horseshoe pits ..., ball field, pit toilets, water pump, volleyball court, canoe landing and 27-site campground'), read 2026-11-17; Campendium review 2023-08-03 ('Potable Water, pit latrines'); The Dyrt review 2021-10-10 ('no electricity or showers', pre-electric)

season.note: Full season May 1-Sep 15; Sep 16-Nov 30 off-season camping at reduced rates.

season_source: https://eauclairecounty.gov/departments/parks_forest/camping.php ('Coon Fork and Harstad campgrounds are open for the season May 1st - September 15th'); https://www.eccountyparks.com/parks/parks-and-shelters/harstad_county_park_shelter/details/ ('Off-Season Camping September 16 through November 30 - $12/night for non-electric and $17/night for electric site'), read 2026-11-17

fees.note: Self-registration: $20 non-electric, $25 electric; $120/$150 a week. Off-season (Sep 16-Nov 30): $12 non-electric, $17 electric.

fees_source: https://www.eccountyparks.com/parks/parks-and-shelters/harstad_county_park_shelter/details/ ('Camping (self-registration at the park) - $20.00/night for non-electric - $120.00/week (7 nights) $25.00/night for electric site - $150.00/week (7 nights)'; 'Off-Season Camping September 16 through November 30 - $12/night for non-electric and $17/night for electric site'), read 2026-11-17
flags: Pin: centre of the campsite spurs from imagery (44.73830,-91.16750); Google's pin 44.73905,-91.16974 is the entrance road off CTH HHH, ~190 m WNW.

Phone: county page gives (715) 975-0000 'May 1 through October 15' (the Coon Fork campground office, same as entry 3457); off-season the department is (715) 839-4783. Google lists 715-839-4738 (likely a transposition). Campendium's 715-286-5536 is old.
Electric is recent: reviews 2018-2023 say no electricity; the county page now lists 10 sites at 50/30/20 amp and a $25 electric rate. Which 10 sites is unpublished.
hookups water/sewer false read from the county's facilities list (a water pump, pit toilets, no water/sewer service named) - drop them if AWH prefers absent.

Not on the Konect Parks online booking system (only Coon Fork is); FCFS self-registration. No max-stay rule found for Harstad (the 14-night rule in the 2026 policies PDF is Coon Fork's). Eau Claire County vehicle entrance passes (Yodel Pass from 2026-11-03) cover Harstad; whether campers also need one is not stated.
Dump station: none listed at Harstad (Coon Fork, 13 km, has one) - left absent.
